decisions.reason: The updated Flat Plan changes the magazine's arrangement basis but does not change the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style requirement.
Providing a newer Flat Plan does not change the requirement to remediate article image quality with AI when necessary.
The newer Flat Plan guides content arrangement but does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The source does not resume or alter the deferred print-ready output requirement or any of its format, resolution, trim, or bleed attributes.
The updated Flat Plan does not change the specified website as the source of magazine articles.
The updated Flat Plan does not change the requirement for every article to include the author's name and a small circular author photo.
